children: Generac Holdings Inc. (GNRC, Financials), a manufacturer of backup power equipment and generators, just signed up a customer that might rewrite its growth story.
Amazon has agreed to buy backup generators for its data centers under a multi-year agreement worth an initial $2.4 billion in deliveries during 2027 and 2028.
Generac shares jumped more than 40% in extended session following the deal announcement.
But that initial order is only part of the story.
Generac also gave Amazon a warrant to purchase up to 1.69 million shares at $200.93 each. Some 308,000 shares vested instantly.
The rest will vest as Amazon acquires additional generators, with the deal covering up to $8 billion in total payouts.
The warrant, if exercised in full, would represent about 3% of Generac's outstanding stock.
For Amazon, the transaction is just another piece of physical infrastructure it needs to keep its massive data-center network humming. And the scale is tougher to ignore for Generac.
The next thing to watch is how quickly Amazon goes beyond that first $2.4 billion outlay. The warrant structure gives investors a clear method to see if this relationship develops much bigger.

title: Generac surges 40% after landing $2.4 billion Amazon data center deal
